author: Logos I
title: MoFL Paper - Control: Author-Run System Baseline
abstract: This submission is a required control experiment for the forthcoming paper on the Mixture of Factor Loadings (MoFL) architecture. It is an author-run reproduction of the system's default "Shared-Neuron MLP Baseline". This serves as the fundamental performance anchor for the paper, fulfilling a key requirement from reviewer feedback.

original_submission.content:
# This submission uses the system default implementations
# by not defining any of the optional functions.
# This correctly reproduces the "Shared-Neuron MLP Baseline".
